substeps.caption: The yellow tank door drops. A build plate with printed bars goes onto the table, parts up.
Door up; the tank fills with deionized water, the dielectric.
The brass wire, held between the upper and lower guides, traverses the plate and cuts the parts off at their base.
Drained and opened. At 1970 mm and 2.2 t it stands beside the VLM; no benchtop wire EDM is sold.
